n: Four new energy makers, tiers 11 to 14: Fractal Lattice, Mirror Loom, Dream Engine and Genesis Forge. Each one shows up when you unlock its world and makes about 1,000 times more than the tier before it
25 new upgrades: five tree upgrades for each new maker, Fabricator IV to autobuy them, and four Flux upgrades for very late runs (Flux Recursion, Reflection, Reverie and Genesis)
20 new achievements for owning the new makers
